faq.question: What is your standard turnaround time?
faq.answer: Our standard delivery time is 24 hours for most orders under 500 images. For bulk enterprise orders, we establish a custom timeline, typically 48-72 hours, to ensure quality control at scale.

faq.question: How do I upload my files?
faq.answer: We support all major file sharing platforms including WeTransfer, Dropbox, and Google Drive. For enterprise clients, we can set up a dedicated FTP/SFTP server or integrate directly with your DAM system.

faq.question: Do you offer bulk discounts?
faq.answer: Yes, we offer tiered pricing for high-volume clients. If you process more than 1,000 images per month, contact our sales team for a custom quote with significant volume discounts.

faq.question: What if I am not satisfied with the results?
faq.answer: We offer free unlimited revisions until you are 100% satisfied. Our 'Human-in-the-Loop' process ensures high quality, but if something is missed, we fix it immediately at no extra cost.
